title: EFC — How Does Balance Shape Universal Structures?
abstract: Examines how balance, symmetry, and dynamic equilibrium form the basis for universal structure in the EFC framework. Focuses on how opposing gradients, entropic pressures, and energy-flow resistance produce stable large-scale configurations across scales.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Balance-driven structure formation across cosmic scales

key_results: Stable structures emerge from balance of opposing entropy gradients
Symmetry breaking driven by flow-resistance imbalance
Universal scale relations from equilibrium conditions
Multi-scale structure hierarchy from gradient balance topology
